note: Elberon is taken as the wide road with heavy double lines and streetcar tracks running NE from the Mt. Hope/Ansonia area (it carries the ELBERON label at 3950-4100,3500). It ends at State Ave in a multi-street junction where Warsaw Ave also comes in from the NW and English St from the E. The point is the middle of that open junction. The page gutter runs down State Ave at x~5370. The PRICE/MRS lettering in the triangle block is an owner name, not a street.

No Wilsonia Drive printed. N. Chateau Ave (60 ft, x 2593-2685) runs south from Bodley Ave (y 2027-2095) exactly at the expected x, so it is probably the older name. Treat as found only if Wilsonia is that street renamed.

same_names_elsewhere.note: The street printed 'Mt. Hope' leaves Elberon's west curve here and runs SE.

note: The N-S street printed 'Mt. Hope' north of y~3200 continues south as Filson Terrace, which makes a T on Elberon (E-W here, y 3912-3998, with an 8 in. water pipe and 12 in. sewer). A separate street south of Elberon is printed 'Mt. Hope'. I picked the Filson T as nearer the expected point; the expected point itself lies about 150 px east on plain Elberon.

No Kulla Viken Lane on the plate. Mt. Hope runs N-S at x~3480-3590 with a 6 in. water pipe; nothing meets it at y~2735. Nearest side street: Jubalo Terrace meets Mt. Hope from the SW at about (3530,2855). The pink/teal lines at y~2620 are boundary bands, not Nonaly Ave, which ends at Summit Ave.

In 1922 Bodley Ave ends at Summit Ave, a T at about (3088,2062). Between Summit and Mt. Hope (x 3140-3500) there are only City of Cincinnati Subdivision lots, plus a teal boundary band at y~2095. Mt. Hope runs N-S at x~3545 with no street at y~2050.

No Glenway label in the region. W. Eighth runs E-W at y~130-240 along the plate's top edge, east of the gutter. The expected point is on the page gutter (x~5340-5390), and the plate top edge is at y~100-125. West of the gutter a street edge angles NNW from (5295,240) to (5265,125); this may be a street leaving W. Eighth off-plate, but it is unlabelled. State Ave meets W. Eighth at about (5565,185). Two unnamed 'AVE.' streets (x~4680 and x~5130) run north to the Price Hill inclined plane.

No Peggie Lane on the plate. Hatmaker runs E-W at y~650-735; at x~6086 there are solid lots on both sides (148-149 north, 167-169 south). Nearest side street: Storrs Street (60 ft) makes a T north of Hatmaker at about (6298,690).
No Zech Street printed. Prospect Place (y 2212-2257) runs east from Mt. Hope (x 3500-3588) almost exactly at the expected point, so it is probably the older name.

No Mount Echo Drive or Old River Road printed. Kansas Ave runs along the SW plate edge and meets W. Sixth, the road along the railroad with a 16 in. water pipe, at the block corner (2860,6695). Kansas Ave's south half is cut off by the plate edge, so the centre is estimated. Names differ from today's.
